The execution phase includes creating new admin accounts and enabling remote desktop connections as defense evasion measures, allowing continued access even when normal defenses are activated. Meanwhile, credential theft occurs when new user accounts are added with administrative rights. Detailed collection activities follow, gathering specific details such as IP configurations using Python scripts. Finally, additional executables are downloaded and run continuously, ensuring ongoing communication back to the attackers for further commands and control over the infected machine.
